headline: President Biden signed an executive order aimed at strengthening Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act.
what_it_does: This executive order directs federal policy toward strengthening Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act (ACA). No summary was provided, so the specific steps it orders cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: People enrolled in or eligible for Medicaid
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns federal policy on Medicaid, though its specific effects are not described in the available material.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy health insurance through the ACA marketplaces
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns federal policy on the ACA, though its specific effects are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 28, 2021; no specific deadlines are given in the available material.
